mechanism_narrative: Sustained rise in federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods of rising FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strengthening labor market, boosting growth expectations and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines but 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or decline isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% in a month signals strong demand, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 exceeds 2% but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the rise isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in supply (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 increase in the same month
failure_condition: Combined effect of rising INDPRO and GDPC1 does not result in significantly positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05), or one proxy moves while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid inflation (CPIAUCSL rising >1% in a month) triggers market concerns about rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 1% rise but 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or the rise isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, falling UNRATE below 4% signals labor market strengthening, boosting growth and equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE stays above 4% in the regime but 20-day returns are significantly positive (p < 0.05), or the regime isn't active.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in demand (HOUST) and fall in FEDFUNDS (easing) signals accommodative policy and strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises >5% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: Combined effect of rising HOUST and falling FEDFUNDS does not result in significantly positive returns (p > 0.05), or one movement occurs without the other.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle supply expansion regime, sustained rise in INDPRO signals strong production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises in the regime but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the regime isn't active.
